attempts.name: shake_head
attempts.prompt: Stand with feet planted and arms relaxed. Gently shake the head no twice, then face forward and return to rest.
attempts.reason: Combined head/neck yaw stays about 4 to 31 degrees on one side; browser preview also shows arms drawn behind the body. Does not meet alternating left/right head shake.

attempts.name: shake_head
attempts.prompt: Face forward, arms hanging at sides, feet still. Turn head left, right, left, right to say no, then face forward.
attempts.adaptation: Source window 0.35-2.4 seconds retimed to 1.35 seconds after user feedback. Updated Chrome preview replayed; user subjective acceptance pending.

attempts.name: explain
attempts.prompt: Stand with feet planted. Open both hands at waist height, palms up, gently explain, then lower both arms to rest.
attempts.visualEvidence: User preferred natural neutral forearms but reported lowering still crossed the dress. Actual skinned-triangle tests reproduced crossings around 2.02-2.12s; original idle hand points were inside the skirt. Default dress now uses a 0.22rad forward upper-arm inclination, unchanged lateral angle and neutral forearms; imported models are unaffected. Explanation bakes back to this forward endpoint. 57 frontend tests, lint and build pass, including 60Hz hand/finger-segment triangle intersections and 8mm idle point clearance. Not whole-hand skin-volume collision validation. Chrome WebRTC front/side lowering and idle poses sampled. Final subjective acceptance pending.
